Who is Superblexy Media

Fueled by Passion,
Framed by Vision

I'm Blessing Jimoh, founder of Superblexy Media. I grew up around my father's cameras, started editing at 8, and was getting paid for it by 12. Superblexy Media is what that obsession grew into.

From One Editor to a Full Team

What started as one kid at a computer is now a Lagos-based team of video editors, a videographer, a graphic designer and a social media manager, editing for clients across the US and worldwide.

Together, we’ve edited for clients whose combined audiences reach over 200 million monthly viewers, from the Big Technology Podcast to Indiewalls. Every project still runs on what I started with: story first, everything else after.
